kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-response-rule --next-token 'AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs****' --max-results 50 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --response-rule-id 440918 --response-rule-name 'Send Notification When Generating Urgent Incident' --response-rule-priority 1 --response-execution-condition '[{"left":{"value":"threat_level"},"operator":"equals","right":{"value":"suspicious"}}]' --response-action-type alertWhitelist --response-trigger-type event --response-action-config '[{"actionType":"doPlaybook","playbookName":"block waf IP","playbookUuid":"system_aliyun_waf_whole_process_book","disposeParam":{"period":"7d"}}]' --response-rule-status 0 --response-rule-remark '经核实为低风险告警，按计划定期清理。' --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateResponseRule

parameters.help_en: The token that indicates the position from which to start reading. An empty value indicates that the reading starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data records to return in the current request
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automated response rule
parameters.name: response_rule_id

parameters.example: Send Notification When Generating Urgent Incident
parameters.help_en: The name of the automated response rule
parameters.name: response_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The execution priority of the automated response rule
parameters.help_zh: 自动化响应规则执行优先级
parameters.name: response_rule_priority

parameters.help_en: The trigger condition configuration of the rule
parameters.name: response_execution_condition

parameters.help_en:
The action type of the automated response rule. Valid values:
doPlaybook: Executes a playbook.
changeEventStatus: Updates the event status.
changeThreatLevel: Updates the threat level of the event.
addEventTag: Adds an event tag.
deleteEventTag: Deletes an event tag.
alertWhitelist: Adds an alert to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则动作类型。

doPlaybook：执行剧本
changeEventStatus：更新事件状态
changeThreatLevel：更新事件威胁等级
addEventTag：添加事件标签
deleteEventTag：删除事件标签
alertWhitelist：告警加白
parameters.name: response_action_type

parameters.help_en:
The trigger type of the automated response rule. Valid values:
event: An event occurs.
event_update: An event is updated.
alert: An alert is triggered
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则触发类型。

event：事件发生
event_update：事件更新
alert：告警发生
parameters.name: response_trigger_type

parameters.help_en: The action configuration of the automated response rule
parameters.help_zh: 自动化响应规则执行动作配置
parameters.name: response_action_config

parameters.help_en:
The status of the automated response rule. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
100: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
自动化响应规则状态。

0：未开启
100：已开启
parameters.name: response_rule_status

parameters.example: 经核实为低风险告警，按计划定期清理。
parameters.help_en: The remarks for the response rule
parameters.name: response_rule_remark

ResponseRuleId.description_en: The ID of the automated response rule
